summary: Stephen Jenkins is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. Educated at Harvard University under doctoral supervisors Masatoshi Nagatomi and Charles Hallisey, he served as Professor of Religious Studies at California State Polytechnic University, Humboldt (attested 2010–2013).

Stephen Meredyth Edwardes (1873–1927) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. Educated at Eton College and Christ Church, he served as secretary of the Indo-British Association (~1917–1922) and editor of the Indian Antiquary (1923).
Stephen Montagu Burrows (1856–1935) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He was educated at Eton College (~1869–1875) and Exeter College, Oxford (~1875–1879), where he earned his B.A.

Stephen N. Hay (1925–2001) was a historian and Indologist who earned his Ph.D. from Harvard University. He taught history at the University of Chicago (1956–1964) and the University of California, Santa Barbara (1966–1991).

Stephen Prothero (born 1960) is a religious studies scholar who earned his Ph.D. at Harvard under William R. Hutchison. He serves as the C. Allyn and Elizabeth V. Russell Professor Emeritus of Religion in America at Boston University (~2024).

Stephen R. Bokenkamp (born 1949) specializes in Sinology and religious studies. Educated at UC Berkeley (~1978–1986), he was Associate Professor of Classical Chinese at Indiana University Bloomington (~1989–2007) and became Professor of Chinese at Arizona State University (~2007).
Stephen Suen is a scholar of Buddhist studies. He completed his Ph.D. at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2009) under the supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti.
Stephen Wootton Bushell (1844–1908) was a Sinologist and medical doctor who earned his MD from the University of London. He served as a physician at the British Embassy in Beijing from 1868 to 1900.

Steve Odin (born 1953) is a scholar of philosophy and Japanology who studied under David A. Dilworth and Edward S. Casey at Stony Brook University. In 1982, he became Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.

Steven Collins (1950–2018) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed his D.Phil. at Oxford under Richard Gombrich. He held posts at the University of Bristol and Indiana University Bloomington before joining the University of Chicago in 1991.

Steven Edward Lindquist is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who completed his Ph.D. at the University of Texas at Austin under Patrick Olivelle. He serves as Associate Professor of Religious Studies at Southern Methodist University (attested 2026).

Steven Heine (born 1950) is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who earned his Ph.D. at Temple University. He taught at Pennsylvania State University (~1989–1997) before becoming Professor at Florida International University in 1997.

Steven Lukes (born 1941) is a philosopher and sociologist who completed his doctorate at Oxford. He held fellowships and professorships at Balliol College (1966–1987), the European University Institute, the London School of Economics, and New York University (~2001–2021).

Steven Neal Weinberger is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He completed his M.A. and Ph.D. at the University of Virginia under Jeffrey Hopkins, later holding an attested post there in 2006.

Steven Vose is a scholar of Indology, religious studies, and history. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of Pennsylvania, served as Assistant Professor at Florida International University (2013–2021), and joined the University of Colorado Denver in 2022.
Stewart McFarlane is a scholar of religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Sinology. He held posts in the Department of Religious Studies at Lancaster University, attested in 1991 and 2001.

Sthaneshwar Timalsina (born 1965) is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. After teaching at Nepal Sanskrit University and San Diego State University, he was appointed Endowed Chair in Classical Indic Humanities at Stony Brook University (~2022).
Sthira Bhattacharya is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. Educated at the University of Chicago (Ph.D. 2019–2026), Bhattacharya became a Postdoctoral Teaching Fellow there in 2026.

Stig Wikander (1908–1983) was a Swedish scholar of Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and linguistics. Educated at Uppsala University under Henrik Samuel Nyberg, he served as Chair of Sanskrit and Comparative Indo-European Philology at Uppsala from 1953 to 1974.

Stuart Edward Mann (1905–1986) was a scholar of linguistics and Indology who studied at the University of Bristol. He taught English at Masaryk University (~1929–1931) and Czech and Albanian at the School of Slavonic and East European Studies (1947–1972).
